 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two binary patterns separated by a marker line/column.

    Cells present in both patterns become 2; all other cells become 0.
    """
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Side-by-side panels separated by a 7 column.
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 7 for r in range(h))]
    if divider_cols:
        c = divider_cols[0]
        left, right = c, w - c - 1
        if left != right:
            raise ValueError("Unequal panel widths")
        return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][c + 1 + j] != 0 else 0
                 for j in range(left)] for r in range(h)]

    # Vertically stacked panels separated by a 3 row.
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r])]
    if divider_rows:
        r = divider_rows[0]
        top, bottom = r, h - r - 1
        if top != bottom:
            raise ValueError("Unequal panel heights")
        return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[r + 1 + i][j] != 0 else 0
                 for j in range(w)] for i in range(top)]

    raise ValueError("No panel divider found")
